title: Photo Booth Hire Luton | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Luton and Dunstable for large Asian weddings, banqueting suites, airport hotel events and parties. Enclosed booths. Get a free quote.
h1: Photo Booth Hire in Luton and South Bedfordshire
intro: Luton's banqueting suites host some of the largest weddings in the Home Counties, and its airport hotels host the conferences. Our team runs booths at both, with practical options for privacy at South Asian weddings and branded overlays for corporate work. Packages from £299, delivery and setup included.

sections.heading: Booths that suit Luton's big celebrations
paragraphs: The Party Booth is a strong choice for Luton weddings because it is enclosed with a curtain and gives guests complete privacy while they pose. The 360 Booth is hugely popular at sangeets and milestone birthdays, with guests filmed in slow motion on a rotating platform; we confirm the floor space and power it needs with your venue at quote stage. The Selfie Mirror Pod handles high guest counts with instant prints for everyone in the shot, and the Magic Mirror remains the classic for receptions with a ballroom to fill.

sections.heading: Large South Asian weddings and corporate events
paragraphs: Weddings in Luton frequently run to several hundred guests across more than one day, with a mehndi, a nikah or religious ceremony, and a walima or reception. The booth can be booked for a single evening or for more than one event, and the print template can be changed between days. Where modesty matters, the enclosed Party Booth means nobody outside the curtain sees the photo being taken, and a separate ladies' session can be timed into the running order with the attendant managing the queue. For celebrations held in separate halls, we position the booth in one and move it at an agreed point.

Corporate bookings tend to be at the airport hotels: conferences with an evening dinner, Christmas parties and staff awards. These want a branded overlay, a logo on each print and a next-morning digital gallery, all of which come as standard.

sections.heading: Unloading, parking and setup
paragraphs: Luton's banqueting suites are designed for large deliveries, with loading areas, wide doors and level floors. Airport hotels have service entrances and car parks, and community centres and sports clubs usually have a car park beside the hall. Town-centre venues can be tighter, so for those we agree a loading bay in advance and move the vehicle once the booth is inside.

The attendant arrives about an hour before the hire window and the build takes 45 to 60 minutes, not charged as hire time. One standard socket is enough for all our booths except the Inflatable, and if the function room is upstairs without a lift, telling us at booking means we bring a booth that is comfortable to carry.

sections.heading: Venues around Luton
paragraphs: Asian wedding banqueting suites are the signature venue type, seating hundreds with stage areas and high ceilings that suit a showpiece booth. Airport hotels take the conferences and Christmas parties, community centres in Bury Park, Leagrave and Stopsley host family parties and engagement celebrations, sports clubs host birthdays and presentation nights, and village halls in the surrounding villages host the quieter weddings and anniversaries.

sections.heading: Luton, Dunstable and the surrounding towns
paragraphs: Luton is the largest town in Bedfordshire and anchors our Bedfordshire coverage. We cover the town centre and the districts of Stopsley, Leagrave, Bury Park, Wigmore and Farley Hill, as well as Dunstable and Houghton Regis next door, and we cross into Hertfordshire for Harpenden, Hitchin, Stevenage and Hemel Hempstead. Junctions 10 and 11 of the M1, the A6 and the A505 make most journeys short. Delivery and setup are free; if a travel contribution ever applied for a far-flung venue, it would appear on your quote before you pay a deposit.

sections.heading: Package details
paragraphs: Packages from £299 include a professional attendant, unlimited sessions, props, a custom print or overlay template with text and logo, guest book on print booths, digital copies with email and social sharing, LED lighting and public liability insurance. An £80 deposit secures the date and the balance is due one month before your event. Green screen is an optional extra for themed backdrops, and families across Luton have rated us 5 stars on Trustpilot.

faqs.q: Where will you unload at a Luton banqueting suite or hotel?
faqs.a: Banqueting suites have loading areas and large car parks, so we unload at the service door and park. Airport hotels have delivery entrances. For town-centre venues we agree a loading bay before the day. Once the booth is through the door, the vehicle goes straight to the car park.

faqs.q: Is an upstairs function room a problem?
faqs.a: Only if it comes as a surprise on the night. Given notice, two of the team will carry one of the slim pods up the stairs without any trouble. The Magic Mirror and Inflatable Booth are better in a ground-floor room or a venue with a lift, so tell us the layout when you book.

faqs.q: Do you charge travel to Luton or Dunstable?
faqs.a: No. Delivery, setup and pack-down are included in every package and Luton is well inside our regular area. If a travel contribution ever applied to a far-flung venue, it would be shown clearly on the quote up front, never added afterwards.

faqs.q: Can you arrange a ladies-only session?
faqs.a: Yes. We can set aside a women-only period within the hire with the attendant managing the queue, or use the enclosed Party Booth so photos are taken in private. Give us the running order and we will time it to suit.

faqs.q: Can the booth serve 500 guests in one evening?
faqs.a: Yes. Sessions are unlimited during the hire, the attendant keeps things moving and the mirror booths take up to eight guests per shot. For very large weddings we recommend a longer hire window so everyone who wants a photo gets one.

faqs.q: Can we book the booth for the mehndi and the walima?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask for a quote covering both dates and we will price them together, with a different print template for each day if you like. An £80 deposit secures the dates and the balance is due one month before the first event.
